The '''Phaeda Militia''' was a group of beings from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phaeda/Legends|Phaeda]] who had been drafted into military service by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The militia was defeated and captured by the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] in the [[Essien landing]], and all members were given the option to join the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] military or become [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. Former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Zayne Carrick]] was a member of this militia.
